reviews.title: Vercel for hosting Next JS Apps
reviews.pros: We leverage Vercel to host all of our internally Next JS apps that our team use for managing our internal operations. Vercel offers a great developer experience that is easy to use and deployment of Next JS apps in particular is straightforward.
reviews.cons: We do have to leverage other hosting providers for more backend heavy applications. This isn't a criticism of Vercel directly. It just means we have to manage more accounts across more platforms.
reviews.overall: Overall Vercel is a great hosting provider, particularly for Next JS applications with a clean UI and easy to navigate developer experience.

reviews.title: Deploying projects with Vercel
reviews.pros: Easy configuration, Quick build, Deployments and Prod environment, Env variables easy to configure.
reviews.cons: Maybe I didn't find it yet but not easy to switch a branch from a git repository. Had to unlink it, change branch.
reviews.overall: I'm doing small and medium front-end developments. With Vercel and CI, I can have a production url really quick without 0 configuration.
